description: Taiwan late payment surcharge: 1% of the tax for every 3 days late, transferred to enforcement after 30 days (Tax Collection Act art. 20), plus fine caps: income tax under-reporting up to 2x, not filing up to 3x (Income Tax Act art. 110); business tax evasion up to 5x (Business Tax Act art. 51). Taiwan, as of 2026-11-21 (law.moj.gov.tw and Ministry of Finance). General information and estimates only; no individual tax advice, agency or filing. The 2025 tax year is 114年度, filed in May 2026; national-holiday deadline shifts are not computed, only weekends.
